itemized.notes: 5-page AMENDMENT to the April 5, 2006 interim: p1 cover, p2 Summary Page (totals tranche, not redone), p3 Schedule A form ('See Attached' only), p4 the attached typed sheet headed 'April 5 Donations Amend / Page 1' (7 rows + a $650 total), p5 Schedule B filled in by hand on the county form (3 rows). NOTE ON THE FORM ITSELF: no reporting-period box is checked anywhere on this filing - only the amendment 'Yes' box is ticked - which is why the manifest shows no report_type. THE ATTACHMENT HAS NO DATE COLUMN AT ALL, so all 7 contribution rows carry a blank date with needs_review; none was inferred from the April 5 period. Its FullAddress, City and Zip columns are empty on every row and there is no State column, so no donor geography exists. Schedule B's second row records the county filing fee under the Clerk's personal name ('Sherrie Swenson Co Clrk') and its day digit is overwritten beyond recovery. Summary line 1 is written '650.-' - a trailing dash for no cents.
